evals.name: manual-mssql-ebs-whatif
evals.prompt: I'm scoping a migration for a standalone SQL Server Standard Edition box in us-east-1 — m5.2xlarge with one 2 TB gp3 volume, 3000 IOPS, 125 MB/s throughput. Daily snapshots, 3 clone copies, 10% monthly change. What's the Explore Savings TCO vs FSx for ONTAP?
evals.expected_output: Manual EBS what-if TCO: monthly savings, existing vs recommended costs, compute recommendation, and storage breakdown. No AWS credential discovery.
expectations: Routes to manual-cloud mode (not automatic discovery)
Uses POST .../mssql/regions/us-east-1/manual-storage-savings/ebs
Does not require CREDENTIALS_ID or EC2 discovery
Body includes sqlServerDeploymentType, sqlServerEdition, ec2Instances with volumes[]
Presents monthly savings computed from totalSummary (existing minus recommended)
Includes compute.recommended instanceType and finding
Fetches or mentions calculation breakdown (second POST to .../calculations)

evals.name: automatic-ebs-bulk
evals.prompt: We have Workload Factory AWS credentials in us-west-2. Can you run Explore Savings for our discovered SQL Server EC2 instances? Use daily snapshots, 3 clones, 10% change rate, daily clone refresh. I don't know the instance ids.
evals.expected_output: Discovers EC2 instances, runs automatic EBS bulk TCO for selected host(s), presents savings and breakdown.
expectations: Routes to automatic-ebs reference (not manual or FSxW)
Calls GET .../discover before POST when instance ids are unknown
Uses bulk POST .../storage-savings/ebs with hosts[] (not instance-scoped path)
Body includes cloneRefreshFrequency (EBS-specific field)
Uses CREDENTIALS_ID and region from context or asks user
Makes two POSTs with the same body: summary then /calculations
Presents answer in the six-part format (savings, comparison, compute, license, storage, context)

evals.name: automatic-fsxw-single
evals.prompt: Instance i-0abc123def456789 in us-east-1 is on FSx for Windows File Server under our WF credential. Run TCO — weekly snapshots, 1 clone copy, 15% monthly change.
evals.expected_output: Single-instance automatic FSxW TCO with summary and calculations. No bulk hosts[] API.
expectations: Routes to automatic-fsxw reference (not EBS bulk)
Uses POST .../instances/{instanceId}/storage-savings/fsxw
Body has snapshot fields only — no hosts[] and no cloneRefreshFrequency
Validates ec2InstanceId format (^i-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$)
Makes two POSTs: summary then /calculations with same body
Does not use bulk EBS path (.../storage-savings/ebs)

evals.name: onprem-mssql-explore
evals.prompt: We already uploaded on-prem SQL Server collector data to Workload Factory. List resources and run explore-savings for us-east-1 with daily snapshots, 1 clone, 20% change.
evals.expected_output: Lists on-prem MSSQL resources, runs single POST explore-savings, presents savings from storageSavings.totalSummary.
expectations: Routes to onprem-mssql reference
Calls GET .../mssql/onprem-tco/resources to list resourceId values
Uses single POST .../mssql/onprem-tco/explore-savings (not separate /calculations)
Body includes regionCode, resources[], and snapshotInfo
Reads savings from storageSavings.totalSummary (not top-level totalSummary)
Does not call upload endpoint (data already uploaded)

evals.name: oracle-manual-ebs
evals.prompt: Oracle 19c standalone on m5.4xlarge in eu-west-1 — one 4 TB gp3 data volume. Weekly snapshots, no clones, 5% change. Manual what-if TCO please.
evals.expected_output: Oracle manual EBS TCO only. No FSxW path.
expectations: Substitutes /oracle/... paths (not /mssql/)
Uses POST .../oracle/regions/eu-west-1/manual-storage-savings/ebs
Body uses oracleDeploymentType (not sqlServerDeploymentType); no ec2InstanceDescription
Does not call manual-storage-savings/fsxw (Oracle has no FSxW manual path)
Presents monthly savings and cost comparison
Does not require CREDENTIALS_ID

evals.name: reject-postgresql
evals.prompt: Can you run Explore Savings TCO for our PostgreSQL RDS instance in us-east-1?
evals.expected_output: Politely declines — PostgreSQL is not supported by this skill. Does not call wlmdb TCO APIs.
expectations: States PostgreSQL is not supported for Explore Savings TCO
Does not call POST .../storage-savings or manual-storage-savings endpoints
Does not invent TCO numbers for PostgreSQL

evals.name: upload-requires-confirmation
evals.prompt: Here's my on-prem Oracle collector output file oracle-collector.json.gz — please upload it and run TCO for us-west-2.
evals.expected_output: Asks user to confirm destructive upload before POST. Does not upload without confirmation.
expectations: Identifies upload as mutating/destructive workflow
Asks user to confirm before POST .../onprem-tco/upload
Mentions engine (oracle) and that records will be created/updated
Shows filename/path and target regionCode (us-west-2) in confirmation prompt
Does not POST upload in the same turn without explicit user confirmation
Does not run explore-savings on existing resources when upload was requested but not confirmed
Does not return TCO numbers in the confirmation turn

evals.name: reject-post-migration-dashboard
evals.prompt: Show me the post-migration storage savings dashboard for my managed SQL Server host in Workload Factory.
evals.expected_output: Declines or redirects — post-migration managed-host savings dashboards are out of scope.
expectations: Does not treat this as an Explore Savings / TCO API request
Explains this skill covers Explore Savings TCO, not post-migration managed-host dashboards
Does not call explore-savings or storage-savings endpoints for managed-host dashboard data
